_comment: Shot list for the report's loading intro (site/intro-reel.mp4), built by
EVERY SHOT IS PUBLIC DOMAIN OR CC0 AND CARRIES ITS OWN CITATION. The site
does not own newsfilm and does not rehost anyone else's, so the only
footage of world events it can honestly open with is footage that is free
to use and checkable at source. Each entry below names the archive item, a
licence URL taken from that item's own metadata, and the exact in-point, so
the reel can be rebuilt frame for frame by anyone who runs the script.
THE PICTURE IS NOT GRADED, RETIMED OR RECOLOURED. It is cut and scaled and
nothing else. Styling happens in the overlay (grain, scanlines, vignette)
where it cannot be mistaken for the record. A document that alters its own
exhibits has nothing left to be believed about.
The captions date the NEWSREEL, not the event, because that is what the
archive item is: Universal's Nuremberg reel was released 6 Dec 1945, the
trial opened 20 Nov 1945; Explorer 1 launched 31 Jan 1958 and the reel is
dated 3 Feb 1958. Dating the reel is the accurate claim and the smaller one.
